GALLERY

WALLET

V oficiální mobilní aplikaci FORTUNA:LIGY najdete všechny důležité informace na jednom místě. Rozpis zápasů, tabulky, statistiky, soupisky, profily hráčů, podrobné detaily zápasů včetně statistik, ale také novinky z ligy, videa či články o klubech.
Kromě toho si můžete v aplikaci zvolit oblíbený klub a podrobně si nastavit notifikace, které chcete dostávat.

Create and manage your own tournaments. Add Participants, generate a Round Robin schedule, manage results and view standings.

You can grant access to other users either to see the Results and Standings or to manage the Tournament.

Results and standings can be accessed from browser so you can share it with other smartphone or desktop users

Application need network access as all data is stored in the cloud

For problems or suggestions please email the developer at mytournaments@poquesoft.net

The Firstbeat Sports: Athlete app allows individual athletes to view their training load and recovery data collected during team sessions and individual workouts. Athletes can conduct the Quick Recovery Test and upload data remotely for coaches to view in the Firstbeat Sports Dashboard.
Firstbeat Sports: Athlete login credentials are required to use the app (provided by Coach). The only sensor compatible with the app is the Firstbeat Sports Sensor.
